description.zh: 创建时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式。
description.en: The end time when the specified instance is created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 创建时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式。
description.en: The start time when the specified instance is created. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 结束时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Example: 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

description.zh: 结束时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Example: 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

description.zh: 实例ID。多个ID用英文逗号分隔，最大不超过100个。
description.en: The ID of the instance. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 100 IDs.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 每页条数，默认值为20，最大不超过300个。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
产品代码。可通过接口**QueryProductList**查询产品代码。

> 当设置了region时，不为空。
description.en:
The code of the service. You can query the service code by calling the **QueryProductList** operation or viewing **Codes of Alibaba Cloud services**.

>This parameter cannot be left empty if the region is specified.
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

description.zh:
续费状态，取值：
- AutoRenewal：自动续费。
- ManualRenewal：手动续费。
- NotRenewal：不续费。
description.en:
The renewal status of the specified instance. Valid values:

*   AutoRenewal: The instance is automatically renewed.
*   ManualRenewal: The instance is manually renewed.
*   NotRenewal: The instance is not renewed.

description.zh:
订阅类型。
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   Subscription: subscription
*   PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
